{{Quote|The flames will die when we win Corellia. Appreciate the fire while it lasts.|Velash|<ref name="Stoking the Inferno" />}}
'''Velash''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who served in the [[Battle of Corellia]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
===Flames of Corellia===
{{Quote|I came to nurse the inferno and watch the blaze consume the rebels. Sadly, the flames were denied their pleasure.|Velash laments the escape of rebels from Imperial bombing runs|<ref name="Stoking the Inferno" />}}
In [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR dates|4}}</ref> the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Velash of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] was stationed in [[Labor Valley]] of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. She was situated by a [[Tent/Legends|tent]] near the Labor Valley tram station.<ref name="Stoking the Inferno" />

At the [[Time/Legends|time]], a [[Battle of Corellia|battle]] for control against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] raged across the world, and during [[Politics/Legends|Imperial]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]]-[[Bombing run|strikes]] against rebel [[Factory/Legends|factories]] in the area, [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Velash observed several [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] rebels surviving the [[firebomb]]ing campaign.<ref name="Stoking the Inferno" />

===Stoking the Inferno===
{{Quote|I'd cast them into the inferno myself, but the flames, so close I&ndash;I'd never resist them. Perhaps you could fuel the blaze with rebel blood.|Velash enlists another to pacify the rebels|<ref name="Stoking the Inferno" />}}
Dissatisfied, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] sought assistance from an Empire-aligned individual to immediately exterminate a Republic medical camp where the remaining rebels were receiving treatment. Accepting the mission, the Imperial assaulted the multi-[[Tent/Legends|tented]] medical camp, and struck down Republic medtechs, their [[Color/Legends|blue and white]]-[[Armor/Legends|armored]] [[Republic trooper]]s, as well as rebel forces in the area.<ref name="Stoking the Inferno" />

The Imperial then returned to Velash to report of the mission's success. Noting the weakening of the Corellian rebellion, Velash expressed her assurance that the rebels would be reduced to ashes, and provided material reward in the form of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Stoking the Inferno" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|The flames called you here, too, didn't they? Pity you missed the show. Our bombs plummeted in silence, then blossomed, giving birth to the magnificent inferno. I yearn for the flame's warm embrace. Instead, I could only watch the fire reduce rebel factories to ash.|Velash introduces herself|<ref name="Stoking the Inferno" />}}
Driven by a desire to fan the flames of destruction, Lord Velash had an urge of using the Empire's enemies as sacrificial items to be given to death through [[Fire/Legends|fire]], in the worry that the last embers of mayhem would be lost. Thus, the Sith relished the chaos of battlefields and the unceasing deaths of enemies, holding the blazes in reverence.<ref name="Stoking the Inferno" />

Velash admitted that her mind wandered when "the flames are close," and often spoke dramatically with references to fire. She spoke in<ref name="Stoking the Inferno" /> [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]].<ref name="The Written Word">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref>

The female Human Sith Lord had a pair of blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and [[Copper/Legends|copper]]-colored skin, though she lacked hair, with the left side of her face suffered severe burn scars.<ref name="Stoking the Inferno" />

==Equipment==
During the battle of Corellia, Lord Velash wore a white-colored light Sith armor and donned purple pigment accents beneath her eye sockets.<ref name="Stoking the Inferno" />

==Behind the scenes==
Velash first appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a quest giver, where she is voiced by [[Kosha Engler]].<ref name="Stoking the Inferno" />
